$comment: Which module folder each ppclip file belongs to. Paths are Paperclip-relative; the first matching rule wins. tools/export.mjs refuses files that match no rule.

modules.title: Core
modules.summary: Settings → ppclip module switches, shared server route access, the local launcher, and small shared helpers.

modules.title: Team page
modules.summary: The /team canvas with reporting and work lines, Edit mode, Magic sort and group colours.

modules.title: Live runs
modules.summary: The Live runs page as one large card per agent with live activity, current task and last reply.

modules.title: Providers
modules.summary: Top-bar usage bars, dashboard subscription usage, the Providers panel and automatic provider switching.

modules.title: Run controls
modules.summary: Team Unlimited / Drain / Resume, daily runs left, and drain after next run.

modules.title: Computer use
modules.summary: A sandboxed Linux desktop and Chromium per agent in Docker, with live view, takeover and agent tools over MCP.

modules.title: Agents and sidebar
modules.summary: Attention statuses, pending confirmations, urgency ordering, and the Agents page extra columns and task hover card.

modules.title: Task chat
modules.summary: Run scoping, follow-up run dividers, Worked rows under replies, and matching agents by ID in task chat.

modules.title: Fixes
modules.summary: Repair of agents stuck on running, live list refresh, ignoring deleted replies, and Claude/Codex sign-in on Windows.
